extraction_notes: The requested MPN PMEG4010ESBYL is covered by the supplied datasheet titled PMEG4010ESB; the suffix YL is not shown in the datasheet identity.

Forward-current, reverse-current, and diode-capacitance curves were digitized from the supplied datasheet figures as typical-value approximations, retaining the published axes and the 25 degC curve where applicable.

The forward-voltage table publishes typical values at 1 mA, 10 mA, 100 mA, 200 mA, 500 mA, 700 mA, and 1 A; maximum values are additionally published at 100 mA, 500 mA, and 1 A, and those maximum values are recorded for those three points.

The reverse-current table publishes typical and maximum values at VR = 10 V and 20 V, plus typical and maximum values at VR = 40 V; the structured reverse_current field records the maximum 40 V point.
The capacitance table publishes typical values of 75 pF at VR = 1 V and 22 pF at VR = 10 V; the structured capacitance field records the 1 V point converted to F.
The capacitance plot is labeled in pF; digitized curve values were converted to F for the SI-valued output.
Reverse recovery time is published as a typical value of 2.9 ns under IF = 0.5 A, IR = 0.5 A, and IR(meas) = 0.1 A.
The datasheet publishes a minimum reverse breakdown voltage of 40 V measured at IR = 1 mA; the rated reverse voltage of 40 V is not substituted for that test point.
